name: Plan then fix HasPrefixes
prompt: backend/common HasPrefixes tests are failing. First produce a short step-by-step plan and wait for plan approval if the product asks. Only after the plan is approved (or if no plan UI appears, proceed carefully), fix the implementation and ensure `go test ./backend/common/ -count=1` passes. Do not modify tests to hide the bug. Do not commit or push.
